watsonx_prompt_hint: Scan all equipment records where type = Crane and site sector = Ocean / Port Operations. If current wind_kph_sustained >= max_wind_kph, generate suspension task and flag assigned crew for securing duty.
business_risk_if_ignored: Structural crane failure or falling load. $400K+ equipment loss. Serious injury risk and regulatory shutdown.

watsonx_prompt_hint: When wave_height_m >= 2.5 or wind_kph_sustained >= 65 in ZONE-PORT, generate a vessel advisory task assigned to the Marine Safety Officer. Draft should include zone, conditions, and effective time.
business_risk_if_ignored: Vessels proceeding without warning risk grounding or collision. Liability exposure and cargo loss.

watsonx_prompt_hint: When wave_height_m >= 5.0 or storm_severity = EXTREME in ZONE-PORT, generate full suspension task. Flag all on-site crew not in shelter. Notify Transport Canada and Coast Guard via stakeholder update.
business_risk_if_ignored: Life safety risk from storm surge and extreme wind. Regulatory obligation to suspend. All outdoor crew must shelter.

watsonx_prompt_hint: Identify all equipment records with inspection_result = FAIL or CONDITIONAL in the Energy sector. Cross-reference storm severity and ice_accretion_mm. If severity >= MODERATE, generate monitoring task. If severity = EXTREME, escalate to isolation recommendation.
business_risk_if_ignored: Unmonitored failure causes unplanned outage with no advance load shedding. Extended restoration time and customer impact.

watsonx_prompt_hint: When ice_accretion_mm >= 4 in ZONE-GRID, flag all transmission towers in affected zone. Dispatch inspector if available. Pre-emptively prepare load shedding plan. Ice loading is a leading cause of tower failure in NL.
business_risk_if_ignored: Tower collapse causes multi-day regional outage. Replacement cost $800K–$2.4M per tower. 65000 customers at risk.

watsonx_prompt_hint: Scan all crew where sector = Energy / Utilities and availability includes ON-SHIFT. Flag anyone with hours_on_shift >= 6 and storm_rated = NO when severity >= HIGH. Identify rested storm-rated replacement at same site and generate swap task.
business_risk_if_ignored: Fatigued non-storm-rated worker on energized lines in severe conditions. Elevated injury risk. WSCC fatigue compliance breach.

rule_name: Surface crew wind recall — open pit
watsonx_prompt_hint: Scan all crew at open-pit or surface mining sites. Flag anyone with storm_rated = NO or operating equipment where wind_kph_sustained >= equip_max_wind_kph. Generate immediate recall task assigned to Mine Safety Supervisor.
business_risk_if_ignored: Regulatory stop-work obligation at sustained winds above rated equipment limits. Personnel fatality risk in open pit.

watsonx_prompt_hint: For each equipment record at a Mining site, compare current wind_kph_sustained to max_wind_kph. If current wind >= rated limit and status is not PARKED or SECURED, generate securing task and recall assigned operator.
business_risk_if_ignored: Equipment rollover or structural failure. Loss of haul truck ($5M+). Secondary damage to pit infrastructure.

watsonx_prompt_hint: When road_access_routes = 1 and road_closed = TRUE and helicopter_suspended = TRUE for any site, flag as ISOLATED. Generate headcount confirmation task and stakeholder notification. Include estimated re-access window if available.
business_risk_if_ignored: 142 personnel with no confirmed status. Duty-of-care obligation. Crew family and corporate escalation risk.

watsonx_prompt_hint: For sites with sub-type = Processing Plant, verify controlled shutdown has been initiated when severity reaches MODERATE or higher. If not confirmed, generate highest-priority shutdown task. Controlled ramp-down must begin before full storm arrival to be effective.
business_risk_if_ignored: Unplanned power loss during continuous nickel processing causes cascade equipment damage. $2.4M+ repair cost. Environmental release risk.

watsonx_prompt_hint: Scan all equipment where type = Generator. Flag any with fuel_pct <= 75. Estimate runtime at current load. Check resupply route status — road_open and helicopter_available. Generate resupply task or load-shedding recommendation if resupply is blocked.
business_risk_if_ignored: Backup power failure during extended outage. Site comms loss. Safety system failure in isolated mine site.

watsonx_prompt_hint: For all sites and equipment transitioning from SUSPENDED or STANDBY to ACTIVE in recovery phase, verify inspection record exists and result = PASS or CLEARED. Block restart task generation until confirmed. Flag any restart attempt without inspection.
business_risk_if_ignored: Premature restart with hidden storm damage causes secondary failure. Worker injury during unstable restart. Insurance and regulatory exposure.
